import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])

    # Store base-w digits (1-indexed for easier translation)
    a = [0] * 60  # enough for typical constraints
    n = 0
    while m > 0:
        n += 1
        a[n] = m % w
        m //= w

    ok = True
    i = 1
    while i <= n:
        if a[i] > 1:
            a[i] += 1
            if a[i] == w:
                # carry
                while i <= n and a[i] >= w:
                    a[i] = 0
                    i += 1
                    a[i] += 1
            else:
                i += 1
            if a[i - 1] > 1:
                ok = False
                break
        else:
            i += 1

    sys.stdout.write("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
